purpose: Additional synthetic last-sanity check; never VCM training or human qualification
weights_license: Apache-2.0 upstream; preserve upstream notices; mirror card MIT is not a relicensing of weights
voice_metadata_source: Upstream VOICES.md preset labels; not inferred human demographics
device: CPUExecutionProvider; do not compete with an active A100 training job
resampling: scipy.signal.resample_poly up=2 down=3; PCM_16 WAV; no truncation or prompt padding
scope: Every exact OptionB case, personal extension and selected catalog entry in the bound contract; identical speech may share one WAV but retains all case references
inference_input: WAV bytes only, through AudioService and IntentSlotsRuntime; expected labels stay outside inference
quality_review: Every unique WAV independently listened to before VCM results; exact words, no clipping/truncation/artifacts; quality at least 4/5; bind reviewer, timestamp and SHA-256
synthetic_pass_gate: 100% accepted exact typed positives and correct specified negative rejections, every voice/track, with no faults, missing outputs, missing QA or missing cases
physical_pi: deferred by user; official live benchmark and room playback are not simulated accuracy evidence
failure_policy: Preserve failures; no outcome-driven re-synthesis, prompt edits, threshold changes or fitting on this suite. A follow-up model requires a new protocol and fresh independent confirmation.
